description: Committed credentials sitting inside vendored paths — one in `__generated__/` codegen output, one in the `components/ui/` directory where shadcn primitives live. Those paths are held out of the grade for code-pattern rules, and this fixture pins the exception: a credential in the repository is live and is the author's leak no matter which directory produced the file. 'The generator wrote it' is a true statement about the surrounding code and a meaningless one about the key. Without this carve-out, the vendored-path fix would have quietly stopped grading hardcoded API keys — a worse failure than the false positives it exists to remove.
